description: This file contains a Smarty plugin function 'html_select_time' that generates HTML dropdowns for selecting time components (hours, minutes, seconds, meridian). It is used within the Smarty templating system to facilitate time input forms.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_select_time
methods.description: Generates HTML select elements for time input, with configurable options for hours, minutes, seconds, and meridian, using Smarty templating system.
